name: open-code-desk
description: A local-first, approval-driven AI coding desktop application.

scripts.test:e2e:packaged-core: playwright test tests/e2e/provider-chat.spec.ts tests/e2e/change-review.spec.ts tests/e2e/command-git-context.spec.ts tests/e2e/run-execution.spec.ts tests/e2e/debug-session.spec.ts tests/e2e/python-debug-session.spec.ts tests/e2e/debug-ai-repair.spec.ts tests/e2e/project-tasks.spec.ts tests/e2e/compound-run.spec.ts
scripts.package:win: pnpm --filter @open-code-desk/desktop package:win && node apps/desktop/scripts/verify-packaged-runtime.mjs --platform win32 --release-dir release && pnpm release:metadata && pnpm release:checksums
scripts.package:mac: pnpm --filter @open-code-desk/desktop package:mac && node apps/desktop/scripts/verify-packaged-runtime.mjs --platform darwin --release-dir release && pnpm release:metadata && pnpm release:checksums
scripts.package:mac:arm64: pnpm --filter @open-code-desk/desktop package:mac:arm64 && node apps/desktop/scripts/verify-packaged-runtime.mjs --platform darwin --release-dir release --arch arm64 && pnpm release:metadata && pnpm release:checksums
scripts.package:linux: pnpm --filter @open-code-desk/desktop package:linux && node apps/desktop/scripts/verify-packaged-runtime.mjs --platform linux --release-dir release && pnpm release:metadata && pnpm release:checksums
scripts.release:metadata: pnpm security:secrets && pnpm security:dependency-audit && pnpm release:sbom && pnpm security:licenses
